name: agent-fleet
description: Self-hosted Claude Code session manager, and the multi-host control plane around it — sandboxes, scheduling, and a phone that can reach any of it.

scripts.deploy: echo '>>> config: worker/wrangler.toml, the fork-safe default. This replaces the Worker named agent-fleet-coordinator on whatever account wrangler is logged into - on the upstream repo that is the production coordinator, which deploys via CI with wrangler.production.toml instead.' && npm --prefix worker install && npm --prefix worker run deploy

AGENT_FLEET_API_TOKEN.description: Break-glass admin credential, and a fresh deploy's first way in — until sign-in is configured, a coordinator without it refuses every request. Generate one: `openssl rand -hex 24`. It can stop every session and revoke every host; phones sign in and are issued credentials of their own.

AGENT_FLEET_AUTH_ALLOW.description: Who may sign in: comma-separated full addresses or `@domain`, e.g. `you@gmail.com,@example.org`. Empty admits nobody, deliberately — leave this empty and no phone can sign in until you set it later with `wrangler secret put`. Sign-in also needs two public `[vars]` copied into worker/wrangler.toml — see [docs/coordinator-deploy.md](https://github.com/TheTechNetwork/Fleetwright/blob/main/docs/coordinator-deploy.md).
